entities.summary: Yakov Hanecki, real name Jakub Fürstenberg (Fuerstenberg) also known as Kuba was a prominent Polish communist and close associate of Vladimir Lenin, famous as one of the financial wizards who arranged, through his close working relationship with Alexander Parvus, funding for the Bolsheviks who led the October Revolution of 1917 – after which he served as a middle ranking Soviet official until his arrest and execution in 1937.
